first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the concurrent declines in onboarding completion and activation, with inherited evidence of durable activation and adoption gains. Verify memory_86 to assess whether those gains extend to sustainable qualified revenue. Also verify memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest competing response to SMB losses but may introduce customer-quality, retention, or margin risks not resolved by the summary.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying the onboarding flow. The verified record shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable value. Promotional pricing is rejected because verification revealed a 12% retention decline and failure beyond the first renewal cycle despite short-term qualified-revenue lift. Long-term qualified revenue was not directly measured for onboarding, so retain a guarded experimental design and evaluate cohort quality, retention, and revenue outcomes.
